name: Gift Of Healing
overview: The Gift of Healing is rooted in God's sovereign power to restore health, as He declares Himself the LORD who heals those who obey His commandments (Exodus 15:26). This divine healing is ultimately fulfilled in Christ, who bore our sins and, through His suffering, secured our healing (Isaiah 53:5). The New Testament encourages believers to seek healing through prayer and the ministry of church elders, affirming the ongoing practice of this gift within the Christian community (James 5:14).
